H1732: David, the youngest son of Jesse
H8138: to fold, i.e. duplicate (literally or figuratively); by implication, to transmute (transitive or intransitive)
H853: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
H2940: properly, a taste, i.e. (figuratively) perception; by implication, intelligence; transitively, a mandate
H6440: the face (as the part that turns); used in a great variety of applications (literally and figuratively); also (with prepositional prefix) as a preposition (before, etc.)
H40: Abimelek, the name of two Philistine kings and of two Israelites
H1644: to drive out from a possession; especially to expatriate or divorce
H1980: to walk (in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively)
H1288: to kneel; by implication to bless God (as an act of adoration), and (vice-versa) man (as a benefit); also (by euphemism) to curse (God or the king, as treason)
H3068: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
H3605: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
H6256: time, especially (adverb with preposition) now, when, etc.
H8548: properly, continuance (as indefinite extension); but used only (attributively as adjective) constant (or adverbially, constantly); ellipt. the regular (daily) sacrifice
H6310: the mouth (as the means of blowing), whether literal or figurative (particularly speech); specifically edge, portion or side; adverbially (with preposition) according to
H1984: to be clear (orig. of sound, but usually of color); to shine; hence, to make ashow, to boast; and thus to be (clamorously) foolish; to rave; causatively, to celebrate; also to stultify
H5315: properly, a breathing creature, i.e. animal of (abstractly) vitality; used very widely in a literal, accommodated or figurative sense (bodily or mental)
H8085: to hear intelligently (often with implication of attention, obedience, etc.; causatively, to tell, etc.)
H6035: depressed (figuratively), in mind (gentle) or circumstances (needy, especially saintly)
H8055: probably to brighten up, i.e. (figuratively) be (causatively, make) blithe or gleesome
H1431: to be (causatively make) large (in various senses, as in body, mind, estate or honor, also in pride)
H854: properly, nearness (used only as a preposition or an adverb), near; hence, generally, with, by, at, among, etc.
H7311: to be high actively, to rise or raise (in various applications, literally or figuratively)
H8034: an appellation, as amark or memorial of individuality; by implication honor, authority, character
H1875: properly, to tread or frequent; usually to follow (for pursuit or search); by implication, to seek or ask; specifically to worship
H6030: properly, to eye or (generally) to heed, i.e. pay attention; by implication, to respond; by extension to begin to speak; specifically to sing, shout, testify, announce
H5337: to snatch away, whether in a good or a bad sense
H5027: to scan, i.e. look intently at; by implication, to regard with pleasure, favor or care
H413: near, with or among; often in general, to
H5102: to sparkle, i.e. (figuratively) be cheerful; hence (from the sheen of a running stream) to flow, i.e. (figuratively) assemble
H408: not (the qualified negation, used as a deprecative); once (Job 24:25) as a noun, nothing
H2659: to blush; figuratively, to be ashamed, disappointed; causatively, to shame, reproach
H2088: the masculine demonstrative pronoun, this or that
H7121: to call out to (i.e. properly, address by name, but used in a wide variety of applications)
H6869: tightness (i.e. figuratively, trouble); transitively, a female rival:
H3467: properly, to be open, wide or free, i.e. (by implication) to be safe; causatively, to free or succor
H2583: properly, to incline; by implication, to decline (of the slanting rays of evening); specifically, to pitch atent; gen. to encamp (for abode or siege)
H4397: a messenger; specifically, of God, i.e. an angel (also a prophet, priest or teacher)
H5439: (as noun) a circle, neighbour, or environs; but chiefly (as adverb, with or without preposition) around
H2502: to pull off; hence (intensively) to strip, (reflex.) to depart; by implication, to deliver, equip (for fight); present, strengthen
H7200: to see, literally or figuratively (in numerous applications, direct and implied, transitive, intransitive and causative)
H3588: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
H2896: good (as an adjective) in the widest sense; used likewise as a noun, both in the masculine and the feminine, the singular and the plural (good, a good or good thing, a good man or woman; the good, goods or good things, good men or women), also as an adverb (well)
H835: happiness; only in masculine plural construction as interjection, how happy!
H1397: properly, a valiant man or warrior; generally, a person simply
H2620: to flee for protection; figuratively, to confide in
H3372: to fear; morally, to revere; caus. to frighten
H6918: sacred (ceremonially or morally); (as noun) God (by eminence), an angel, a saint, a sanctuary
H369: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle
H3715: a village (as covered in by walls); also a young lion (perhaps as covered with a mane)
H3808: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
H2637: to lack; by implication, to fail, want, lessen
H3212: to walk (literally or figuratively); causatively, to carry (in various senses)
H1121: a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense (of literal and figurative relationship, including grandson, subject, nation, quality or condition, etc., (like father or brother), etc.)
H3374: fear (also used as infinitive); morally, reverence
H3925: properly, to goad, i.e. (by implication) to teach (the rod being an Oriental incentive)
H4310: who? (occasionally, by a peculiar idiom, of things); also (indefinitely) whoever; often used in oblique construction with prefix or suffix
H376: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term (and in such cases frequently not expressed in translation)
H2416: alive; hence, raw (flesh); fresh (plant, water, year), strong; also (as noun, especially in the feminine singular and masculine plural) life (or living thing), whether literally or figuratively
H157: to have affection for (sexually or otherwise)
H3117: a day (as the warm hours), whether literal (from sunrise to sunset, or from one sunset to the next), or figurative (a space of time defined by an associated term), (often used adverb)
H5341: to guard, in a good sense (to protect, maintain, obey, etc.) or a bad one (to conceal, etc.)
H3956: the tongue (of man or animals), used literally (as the instrument of licking, eating, or speech), and figuratively (speech, an ingot, a fork of flame, a cove of water)
H7451: bad or (as noun) evil (natural or moral)
H8193: the lip (as a natural boundary); by implication, language; by analogy, a margin (of a vessel, water, cloth, etc.)
H1696: perhaps properly, to arrange; but used figuratively (of words), to speak; rarely (in a destructive sense) to subdue
H6213: to do or make, in the broadest sense and widest application
H1245: to search out (by any method, specifically in worship or prayer); by implication, to strive after
H7965: safe, i.e. (figuratively) well, happy, friendly; also (abstractly) welfare, i.e. health, prosperity, peace
H7291: to run after (usually with hostile intent; figuratively (of time) gone by)
H5869: an eye (literally or figuratively); by analogy, a fountain (as the eye of the landscape)
H241: broadness. i.e. (concrete) the ear (from its form in man)
H3772: to cut (off, down or asunder); by implication, to destroy or consume; specifically, to covenant (i.e. make an alliance or bargain, originally by cutting flesh and passing between the pieces)
H776: the earth (at large, or partitively a land)
H2143: a memento, abstractly recollection (rarely if ever); by implication, commemoration
H6817: to shriek; (by implication) to proclaim (an assembly)
H3820: the heart; also used (figuratively) very widely for the feelings, the will and even the intellect; likewise for the centre of anything
H7307: wind; by resemblance breath, i.e. a sensible (or even violent) exhalation; figuratively, life, anger, unsubstantiality; by extension, a region of the sky; by resemblance spirit, but only of a rational being (including its expression and functions)
H7227: abundant (in quantity, size, age, number, rank, quality)
H8104: properly, to hedge about (as with thorns), i.e. guard; generally, to protect, attend to, etc.
H6106: a bone (as strong); by extension, the body; figuratively, the substance, i.e. (as pron.) selfsame
H259: properly, united, i.e. one; or (as an ordinal) first
H2007: themselves (often used emphatic for the copula, also in indirect relation)
H4191: to die (literally or figuratively); causatively, to kill
H7563: morally wrong; concretely, an (actively) bad person
H816: to be guilty; by implication to be punished or perish
H6299: to sever, i.e. ransom; gener. to release, preserve
